nodes.label: Sense HAT tutorial notebook (Parts A+B)
nodes.rationale: Merged from rpi_sense.ipynb and waveshare_sense.ipynb (only the duplicated auth cell trimmed). Shared auth -> 4-hour device lease -> launch container with the part's profile/env -> read sensors (i2cdetect, sense_hat library or Adafruit CircuitPython /examples scripts) -> cleanup. Source inconsistencies (soufianejounaid image name vs ghcr.io code, revision 0xd03115 text vs 0xd03140 code) preserved verbatim.
